title: Complete one bounded DRIVE mission
description:
Objective:
Execute one deliberately narrow installed mission from Frame through lawful Seeds state, target-local candidates, immutable review, serial local integration, reconciliation, and stop-before-shipping.

Acceptance:
- A fixed call-bounded mission uses only qualified gateway routes and immutable artifact handoffs.
- One or two target-local worktrees produce sealed candidates reviewed independently from identical bytes and integrated under WIP-1.
- Dogfood on this repository and one disposable downstream repository reaches reviewed local commits and requests separate shipping authorization.

Authority boundary:
Seeds, reviews, gates, and local commits never authorize fan-in, push, release, or deployment.

title: Add the conductor-only Seeds mutation seam
description:
Objective:
Admit the exact Seeds `init`/`create`/`update`/`dep` subset needed by DRIVE under conductor-owned prestate, CAS, locking, readback, and recovery.

Acceptance:
- Every mutation verifies pinned tuple provenance, exact target, expected queue digest/revision, one-writer ownership, and post-write graph state.
- Malformed, duplicate, stale, contradictory, non-bidirectional, or cyclic JSONL state fails before dependent work proceeds.
- Workers/reviewers emit proposals only; only the conductor may perform an already-authorized queue mutation.

Authority boundary:
Seeds is durable work state, never authority. Mutation approval is operation-specific and cannot be stored in a Seed.

title: Materialize one fixed bounded DRIVE mission
description:
Objective:
Install one nonresumable mission with fixed roles, literal qualified selectors/effort, call limits, deadlines, budgets, tools, and artifact roots.

Acceptance:
- Every role has a unique ordinal/root, immutable input/output receipt, expected call label, and bounded tool set.
- Reviewers consume equal sealed candidate digests and the reconciliation barrier rejects missing, duplicate, stale, or substituted handoffs.
- No hidden retry, fallback, substitution, restart, or resume can produce an admitted terminal success.

Authority boundary:
Mission admission permits bounded artifact production only; repository/queue/fan-in effects require separate conductor operations.

title: Produce target-local candidates and immutable independent reviews
description:
Objective:
Create one or two contained target-local worktrees with disjoint write ownership, then seal candidate commits/diffs and review the identical bytes independently.

Acceptance:
- Every writer has one checkout/write set and all worktrees pass containment, ignore, trust, and baseline preflight.
- Candidate handoffs bind commit/tree/diff, tests, artifact paths, and provenance; reviewers cannot mutate candidate or Seeds state.
- Any review input drift or failed gate invalidates the handoff and blocks integration.

Authority boundary:
Worktree creation/removal and candidate commit are separately authorized local effects; review is advisory evidence.

title: Integrate serially, reconcile Seeds, and stop before shipping
description:
Objective:
Use one WIP-1 integrator to apply accepted immutable candidates, replay gates, update Seeds through the conductor seam, and terminate before publication.

Acceptance:
- Each candidate receives a fresh single-use human fan-in grant bound to the exact candidate, review/gate evidence, target prestate, and named integration effect, followed by exact prestate revalidation, serial application, and post-apply full gates.
- Seeds closes/blocks only after integrated readback matches accepted evidence; ambiguity becomes effect_unknown or blocked rather than success.
- The mission emits the exact reviewed local commit and a separate shipping-authorization request without push, PR, release, or deploy.

Authority boundary:
Fan-in authorization covers only the named candidate and target prestate; it never implies shipping authority.

title: Dogfood the installed journey twice
description:
Objective:
Run the exact installed PRIME → qualified gateway → bounded DRIVE journey on this repository and one disposable downstream repository.

Acceptance:
- Both runs begin from fresh installed bytes, use the admitted queue/route/mission surfaces, and reach reviewed local commits.
- Receipts prove no hidden provider fallback, foreign-file loss, unauthorized queue mutation, parallel fan-in, push, release, or deployment.
- Failures remain diagnosable and recoverable without claiming milestone completion.

Authority boundary:
The self-run and disposable run are evidence-gathering operations; any real activation, inference, fan-in, or publication needs its own approval.

title: Productize gateway-owned execution
description:
Objective:
Turn the proven CLIProxyAPI canary and model policy into the only admitted normal execution path after PRIME.

Acceptance:
- The Workflow overlay is installed and lifecycle-owned with executed-identity proof.
- A qualified gateway-only route admits exact selectors and effort while dead/stale routes fail closed without direct-provider fallback.
- Installed live/dead controls verify model identity, precedence/reload, and absence of provider-native attempts.

Authority boundary:
Gateway configuration, credentials, process lifecycle, and live inference each require their own approved and evidence-bounded operation.

title: Ship the bounded Workflow overlay lifecycle
description:
Objective:
Extend the existing bundle lifecycle with one bounded Workflow entry kind rather than a new installer engine.

Acceptance:
- Install/status/update/uninstall/recovery reuse existing ownership, staging, durability, migration, and modified-foreign-content protections.
- Destination containment and installed-versus-executed identity are verified after host reload.
- Foreign overlay files and user modifications are preserved and reported as conflicts.

Authority boundary:
Installing or reloading the real host overlay is a separately authorized user-configuration effect.

title: Implement the required gateway-only launcher
description:
Objective:
Provide the normal execution launcher through CLIProxyAPI/`claude-code-proxy`, using credential references without exposing credential values.

Acceptance:
- The launcher admits only reviewed gateway configuration and exact requested model/effort/context inputs.
- Provider-native Claude is unavailable to normal execution and may be selected only by an explicit diagnosis/recovery identity.
- Dead, malformed, ambiguous, or unqualified gateway state stops without retrying a direct/provider-native route.

Authority boundary:
Credential material never enters the repository, prompts, receipts, logs, or literal command arguments.

title: Add RouteQualification and exact dispatch admission
description:
Objective:
Keep RuntimeAssignment at exactly 16 fields while separately qualifying route identity, freshness, evidence, and mission-slot eligibility.

Acceptance:
- RouteQualification supports expiry, quarantine, revoke, last-good preservation, duplicate-key rejection, and host/boot/monotonic binding.
- Only exact `gpt-5.6-sol[1m]`, `gpt-5.6-terra[1m]`, `gpt-5.6-luna[1m]`, `claude-fable-5[1m]`, `claude-opus-4-8[1m]`, and `claude-sonnet-5[1m]` Workflow selectors with explicit effort are admitted only after selector-specific qualification; until then, uncertified forms remain denied. RuntimeAssignment continues to store the bare model ID and separate requested context form.
- Requested values never masquerade as provider/model/effort readback, and configuration alone never qualifies a route.

Authority boundary:
Qualification is evidence, not authorization to infer, spend quota, dispatch, or publish.

title: Prove installed routing, precedence, and refusal controls
description:
Objective:
Verify the installed overlay and launcher across positive and negative gateway controls after actual host reload.

Acceptance:
- The first and later Workflow calls execute the exact installed overlay and admitted selector/effort, with correlated model identity readback.
- A live qualified gateway route succeeds and a dead endpoint fails closed with no direct-provider request or hidden fallback.
- Retry, fallback, substitution, restart, and resume denials are observable in the bounded attempt record.

Authority boundary:
Live inference and host reload are separately approved canary effects; passing them does not authorize DRIVE fan-in or shipping.

title: Deliver an installed PRIME → gateway DRIVE → reviewed local commit
description:
Objective:
Deliver the first coherent installed product journey from a fresh bundle install through safe PRIME activation and one gateway-routed bounded DRIVE mission to a reviewed local commit.

Acceptance:
- The Complete PRIME, gateway-owned execution, and bounded DRIVE epics are closed with their acceptance evidence.
- The installed journey reaches a reviewed local commit on this repository and one disposable downstream repository.
- The journey stops before push, release, or deployment and emits a separate shipping-authorization request.

Authority boundary:
This milestone records product completion evidence only. It never authorizes fan-in, push, release, deployment, credentials, or another outward effect.

title: Complete PRIME
description:
Objective:
Turn the shipped offline observer into supported, transactional, recoverable repository activation without importing unrelated V7/archive scope.

Acceptance:
- Public plan/apply/recover complete preflight before effect and produce truthful readback and recovery state.
- Managed worktrees are contained under the target-local `.worktrees/` root and preserve foreign content.
- Fresh greenfield and brownfield installs prove apply, conflict refusal, interruption recovery, idempotent rerun, status, and unchanged foreign bytes.

Authority boundary:
PRIME effects require exact operation-specific approval. This epic defines a fail-closed gateway handoff but does not authorize or implement gateway inference.

title: Promote and reconcile only the minimum PRIME candidate
description:
Objective:
Inventory preserved PRIME/readiness and Seeds/worktree candidates, verify custody against preserved Git objects/evidence, and promote only code required for this slice.

Acceptance:
- Every promoted hunk has an exact source locator, current-slice requirement, and focused test.
- Archive/V7, gateway, and DRIVE implementation are not bulk-merged or counted as shipped.
- Unknown, dirty, or unreviewable candidate bytes are preserved and explicitly deferred.

Authority boundary:
Candidate existence and prior review never authorize integration or effects.
closeReason: Accepted with disposition no-promotion; evidence: docs/progress/2026-07-21-prime-candidate-custody.json; verifier: tests/test_prime_candidate_custody.py

title: Make activation plan/apply/recover transactional
description:
Objective:
Expose supported activation plan/apply/recover commands with one durable PRIME intent and exact prestate/write-set publication semantics.

Acceptance:
- All approvals, conflicts, readiness, targets, and write-set preconditions resolve before line of effect.
- Apply stages bytes privately, publishes with exact prestate checks, reads back every result, and returns nonzero for false readiness or incomplete effects.
- Crash-point tests prove idempotent recover, verified rollback where possible, or explicit effect_unknown without silent success.

Authority boundary:
Each apply/recover operation consumes fresh operation-specific authorization; a plan or Seed is not authority.

title: Adopt managed target-local worktrees and fail-closed readiness
description:
Objective:
Replace sibling-worktree doctrine with contained, ignored target-local `.worktrees/` management and a shared fail-closed readiness guard.

Acceptance:
- Only `<target>/.worktrees/<seed-id>-<slug>` destinations pass containment and ignore preflight.
- Symlinks, mounts, special nodes, occupied foreign paths, and registry drift fail before worktree creation.
- Readiness blocks before queue, trust, worktree, receipt, or dispatch effects when required capabilities or gateway handoff are unresolved.

Authority boundary:
Worktree creation/removal, persistent trust, and later fan-in remain separately authorized effects.

title: Align commands and product claims with executable PRIME
description:
Objective:
Make `/sdlc-init`, README, flagship skill doctrine, and worktree references describe only the tested PRIME surface and controlling gateway posture.

Acceptance:
- All documented commands exist on the installed public surface and match tested exit/readback behavior.
- Normal inference is described as gateway-required; provider-native Claude is diagnosis/recovery-only with no fallback.
- No text claims V7 candidates, ambient Seeds mutation, or an unverified route as shipped capability.

Authority boundary:
Documentation can describe authority requirements but cannot grant them.

title: Prove fresh install through recoverable PRIME activation
description:
Objective:
Run installed-byte greenfield and brownfield journeys through inspect, approved apply, readback, status, interruption recovery, and idempotent rerun.

Acceptance:
- Both journeys use disposable isolated homes/targets and the exact installed bundle rather than source-tree shortcuts.
- Conflict, stale prestate, permission/disk failure, link swap, and crash boundaries fail closed while foreign bytes and Git state remain preserved.
- Focused and full gates pass and the accepted evidence names the exact commit/tree and installed identities.

Authority boundary:
Disposable test effects are bounded to test roots. No real repository activation, trust mutation, inference, push, or release is implied.
